result.summary: Adds an MSVC-specific hook in setup_common.cpp that, when the SUPPRESS_ABORT_MESSAGE environment variable is set, calls _set_abort_behavior(0, _WRITE_ABORT_MSG) to prevent a debug-runtime abort() from popping up a blocking message box. The intent is to stop failing asserts in Windows MSVC-built test/fuzz binaries from causing CI timeouts. The 17-line change only takes effect when the env var is externally set, which is not currently done anywhere in the in-tree CI configuration.
result.problem: On Windows, MSVC debug-runtime builds show a blocking message box when abort() fires (e.g. from a failing assert), which stalls unattended CI runs until a human dismisses it. This affects contributors and CI maintainers running MSVC debug test/fuzz binaries, but only in out-of-tree nightly CI so far; in-tree CI does not build with the debug runtime.

result.card: This PR adds an MSVC-specific hook in setup_common.cpp that suppresses the Windows debug-runtime's blocking abort() message box when the SUPPRESS_ABORT_MESSAGE environment variable is set, aiming to stop failing asserts in MSVC debug test/fuzz binaries from stalling CI. The problem is real for out-of-tree nightly MSVC CI (author shows before/after CI logs), but no in-tree CI job currently sets the variable, so fanquake gave a concept NACK calling the code 'undocumented and unused in this repository,' while hodlinator gave a conditional concept ACK. The author has been silent since 2026-04-29, leaving fanquake's 2026-08-19 question about whether the recently merged #33593 (UCRT runtime switch) obsoletes this PR unanswered. Review is currently paused pending that reply, and the change is marginal in both build and tests categories given its lack of an in-tree consumer.
